children.name: EcoBug, a comprehensive landscaping consultant tool is a one-stop destination for all landscaping solutions be it for an architect, designer, site engineer or student! From analysis and development to maintenance and cost estimation, this software covers the integral stages of landscaping, providing an easy-to-use interface and assessing feasibility of landscape projects both environmentally and economically.
